text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aaaagh! It's finally here! The "Japan Dirt 
Derby"!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The crowd was super hyped too! Man, you 
really can't beat a GI!
choice_data_list: Show me some massive fireworks, okay?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Goes without saying! Just you wait and 
see!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm heading out soon!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Dirt Derby, which crowns the 
champion of the dirt for the Classic year! 
The race will be starting very shortly!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Time to dive into the festival 
stage!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, you're... that person on the 
boss's team, right?

text_block_list.name: Oi Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Looking forward to working with ya 
today.

text_block_list.name: Oi Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The "top spot" around here... We're the 
ones who are gonna take it.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Heheh, look at all that top-tier 
conditioning! Every last one of 'em's 
glaring daggers just to welcome me back, 
huh?)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on!! Let's have ourselves a 
massive brawl!!!
